svg.title: The build flow — discover, grill, spec, implement, evals, demo rehearsal
svg.desc: An animated diagram of the six build stages. Each stage lights up in turn and shows the skill that runs it, the failure it prevents, the file it leaves behind and the signal that it worked: discover produces references/evidence.md, grill produces GLOSSARY.md and ADRs, spec produces acceptance criteria, implement carries them to a 90 percent coverage gate, evals replaces "it seems good" with a number, and demo rehearsal proves it runs from a clean checkout on another machine. An arc from implement back to spec shows that going backwards is the process working. The artefacts accumulate along the bottom as an inventory for demo day, under the rule that spans every stage: verify before you assert, and mark what you could not verify.
svg.text: Six stages. Each one prevents one specific, expensive failure — and makes the next one cheaper.
